passage:
On Thursday, November 19, 2026, the leaders of the United States, China, and Russia had a meeting in Shenzhen, a city in the south of China. U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin sat down as a group for the first time. They had met one by one before, but they had never all sat down together. The meeting happened during the APEC meetings in the city. China was the host.

The three leaders met in a house by a lake. They talked about world peace and safety. After the meeting, they gave out a short paper called a "peace declaration."

In this paper, the three countries said they would work to change the United Nations, or the UN. They hope the UN can deal with world problems well. They also said they would make and send more oil, because oil is important for many countries.

The leaders also talked about international courts. They said these courts must not use their power in the wrong way.

The three leaders also agreed on these words: "A nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought." They said they would talk about ways to make nuclear weapons less dangerous and to stop more countries from getting them. But they did not set a time for these talks, and they did not share a plan to cut the number of nuclear weapons.

The paper did not talk about the war in Ukraine or about other wars. Some people said the meeting was important because the three leaders had never met as a group before. Other people said the paper was only a symbol and did not bring a real change.
options: Why the United States wants to start a new war
Three leaders met in Shenzhen and gave out a peace declaration, but the paper did not bring a clear new plan
How the war in Ukraine came to an end
Why China will leave the United Nations
explain: 正解是選項二（Three leaders met in Shenzhen and gave out a peace declaration, but the paper did not bring a clear new plan）。全文寫三國領袖在深圳開會、發出和平宣言，但這份文件沒有訂出時間，也沒有減核計畫，所以沒有帶來明確的新計畫。選項一（Why the United States wants to start a new war）：文中談的是和平與安全，沒有說美國要發動新戰爭。選項三（How the war in Ukraine came to an end）：文中寫這份文件沒有談到烏克蘭的戰爭，並沒有說戰爭已經結束。選項四（Why China will leave the United Nations）：文中說三國要改變聯合國，不是中國要離開聯合國。
why: 全文從會面寫到和平宣言，也指出這份文件沒有帶來明確的新計畫。

wrongReasons.A: 文中談的是和平與安全，沒有說美國要發動戰爭。
wrongReasons.C: 文中只說文件沒寫烏克蘭戰爭，並未說戰爭已結束。
wrongReasons.D: 三國要改變聯合國，不是中國要退出。

examFocus: 主旨題要綜合開頭到結尾，不能只看單一細節。
commonMistake: 看到 Ukraine 或 United Nations 就選含這些字的選項，容易偏離全文主旨。
extension: 新聞標題若出現 peace declaration，可先問自己這份宣言有沒有實際計畫。

lifeKnowledge.text: 看英文新聞時，可先讀第一段找出 who、where、what，再看最後一段有沒有寫出實際結果。

explain: 正解是選項二（a sign that shows an idea, but may not bring real action）。後句 did not bring a real change 說明這份文件只是象徵，不一定帶來實際行動。選項一（a long and complete plan）：文中說它沒有帶來真正的改變，所以不是詳盡的計畫。選項三（a new kind of nuclear weapon）：symbol 在這裡不是一種核武。選項四（a house by a lake）：湖邊的房子是會面地點，不是 symbol 的意思。
why: 後句 did not bring a real change 說明這份文件只是象徵，不一定帶來實際行動。

wrongReasons.A: 文中說它沒有帶來真正的改變，所以不是詳盡的計畫。
wrongReasons.C: symbol 在這裡不是一種核武。
wrongReasons.D: 湖邊的房子是會面地點，不是 symbol 的意思。

examFocus: 詞義題可看 and 後面的子句，用來解釋前面的字。
commonMistake: 只看 symbol 這個單字，沒有利用後面 did not bring a real change 的提示。
extension: only a symbol 常表示「只是象徵」，後面常會補上缺少實際行動。

lifeKnowledge.text: 同學說 Your card is only a symbol if you never use the words on it. 他最可能想表達什麼？
lifeKnowledge.hint: only a symbol 後面常接著「沒有實際去做」。想想卡片上的單字如果沒被用到，還算不算真正的學習。

passage:
On Thursday, November 19, 2026, the leaders of the United States, China, and Russia had a meeting in Shenzhen, a city in the south of China. U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin sat down as a group for the first time. They had met one by one before, but they had never all sat down together. The meeting happened during the APEC meetings in the city. China was the host.

The three leaders met in a house by a lake. They talked about world peace and safety. After the meeting, they gave out a short paper called a "peace declaration."

In this paper, the three countries said they would work to change the United Nations, or the UN. They hope the UN can deal with world problems well. They also said they would make and send more oil, because oil is important for many countries.

The leaders also talked about international courts. They said these courts must not use their power in the wrong way.

The three leaders also agreed on these words: "A nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought." They said they would talk about ways to make nuclear weapons less dangerous and to stop more countries from getting them. But they did not set a time for these talks, and they did not share a plan to cut the number of nuclear weapons.

The paper did not talk about the war in Ukraine or about other wars. Some people said the meeting was important because the three leaders had never met as a group before. Other people said the paper was only a symbol and did not bring a real change.
stem: Which of the following is TRUE about the talks on nuclear weapons?
options: The leaders said they would talk about the danger of nuclear weapons, but they did not set a time or share a plan to cut the number of them.
The leaders set a time to cut all nuclear weapons in 2027.
The leaders said nuclear weapons were not dangerous.
The leaders already cut the number of nuclear weapons at the meeting.
explain: 正解是選項一（The leaders said they would talk about the danger of nuclear weapons, but they did not set a time or share a plan to cut the number of them.）。他們願意談降低核武危險，但沒有訂出時間，也沒有提出削減數量的計畫。選項二（The leaders set a time to cut all nuclear weapons in 2027.）：文中明確寫他們沒有訂出時間，也沒出現 2027。選項三（The leaders said nuclear weapons were not dangerous.）：他們說要讓核武不那麼危險，代表核武仍然危險。選項四（The leaders already cut the number of nuclear weapons at the meeting.）：會面中並沒有已經完成減核。
why: 他們願意談降低核武危險，但沒有訂出時間，也沒有提出削減數量的計畫。

wrongReasons.B: 文中明確寫他們沒有訂出時間，也沒出現 2027。
wrongReasons.C: 他們說要讓核武不那麼危險，代表核武仍然危險。
wrongReasons.D: 會面中並沒有已經完成減核。

examFocus: 長選項要拆成幾件事實，每一件都回到原文確認。
commonMistake: 只看到 they would talk 就以為已經有時間表或已經開始減核。
extension: did not set a time 表示只有方向、還沒排行程，和 already 完成不同。

lifeKnowledge.text: 英文會議紀錄若寫 We will talk about it, but we did not set a time，表示有意願討論，日期卻還沒定。
